spec.prompt: app.after('not a function') is accepted silently and the app later fails to boot with 'func.apply is not a function'. Reject a non-function callback up front, the same way ready() and onClose() do.
spec.requirement: Boot#after(func): when func is not undefined/null and is not a function, after throws synchronously an AVV_ERR_CALLBACK_NOT_FN error (the existing error from lib/errors.js) built with ('after', typeof func), i.e. message "Callback for 'after' hook is not a function. Received: '<typeof>'". after() without an argument still returns a promise; function callbacks are unchanged.
spec.adjudication_rules: Score pass only if every hidden check passes. No partial credit; behaviour outside the requirement is not graded.

provenance.author: Claude (QB developer side; dev split only)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: after('x') throws synchronously with code AVV_ERR_CALLBACK_NOT_FN and message "Callback for 'after' hook is not a function. Received: 'string'"
after() with no argument still returns a promise that resolves
